clauses.clause: Spread: infected 5 → **≥ 15 at +120 s** (floor 12) → **≥ 25 at +240 s** with an idle remote observer; every new one from a bite.
clauses.note: Both tiers start with 5; low 30/30 and high 44/50 at +120/+240 seconds. All additional turns follow bites, no direct additions; observer has zero deaths, damage, knockdowns and kills.

notes: Native fixture uses ordinary opening then relocates observer remotely.
